messages:
Zoe (Product): Hey team — quick pass on the new 'Get started' banner that shows up for fresh accounts. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/console-banners/starter-banner.png. Looking for quick opinions on: 1) CTA copy, 2) sample project order/labels, 3) a11y/keyboard focus. Low-effort changes only this sprint. Alessandra (Design): Nice! Layout feels roomy. For CTA copy I prefer shorter verbs — examples: 'Start a demo project' or 'Create project'. 'Create your first project' is fine but a bit long for a banner CTA. Samira (Accessibility): Heads up on contrast — current blue (#3b82f6?) on white is fine for large text but if button is only 16px we need 4.5:1. Can you paste the exact hex for the CTA? Also add `aria-label` and ensure visible keyboard focus (2px outline). Kevin (DevEx): For sample projects, reorder to surface the things that show platform strengths: 1) "Starter app (streaming)" 2) "Embeddings demo" 3) "Reranker sample". Default-selection should be Starter app so users immediately see streaming and prompt tooling. Also emit analytics event `onboarding.banner.click` with `project_type` property. Matt L (Eng): Implementation note: banner is client-rendered in the console shell. Quick accessible button pattern we can use: ``` ``` Make sure we don't swallow focus when the modal opens — use `focusTrap` in the modal. Alessandra (Design): Copy tweak suggestion for the microcopy under CTA: 'Takes 2 minutes — no infra required.' Could also try 'Try a sample project in 2 minutes'. Which reads less like a promise? Samira (Accessibility): Prefer '2 minutes' phrasing. Also suggest aria-describedby linking CTA to that microcopy so screen readers hear context: `aria-describedby=\"onboard-banner-note\"`. Use semantic heading for the banner, e.g., `

Try a sample project

`. Zoe (Product): Good recs. Can we A/B test copy A = 'Create project' vs B = 'Start a demo project' at 50/50 and measure day-1 activation (project created within 24h)? Also want the banner to auto-dismiss after a successful project create for that user. Thoughts? Kevin (DevEx): A/B test fine. We'll add experiment flag `banner_cta_copy_v2`. Auto-dismiss: track `project.created` event and set local flag `banner_dismissed_v1`. Make sure server-side override exists for enterprise where product teams want persistent nudges. Matt L (Eng): For auto-dismiss, be careful with multiple devices. Use server-side preference if user is logged in; fallback to localStorage. I'll add 48hr TTL for local-only dismissal. Alessandra (Design): Small design nit: increase focus ring contrast and slightly darken hover state to #0b66ff (from #3b82f6) so there's a clear visual change. Samira (Accessibility): Final checklist from aria POV: 1) aria-label on CTA, 2) aria-describedby for microcopy, 3) heading order preserved, 4) focus visible, 5) color contrast >=4.5:1 for button text (or treat as large text when >18px). I'll run a quick axe check after changes. :eyes: Zoe (Product): Awesome — can someone slip the copy and token changes into a small PR today? I'll wire the analytics and experiment flags. If we have a PR by EOD we can include it in the next staging build. deploy-bot: Staging build queued for 2026-03-23T16:40:00Z (build #4821) — will run after PR merges. Kevin (DevEx): I'll open the PR with the reorder + experiment flag. Assigning to @Matt L for modal/focus parts and @Alessandra for microcopy final. Matt L (Eng): On it. Should be a 1-day worth of work. Zoe (Product): Thanks all!
